item: R6 - the two historical quota-data restore acceptances on independent disposable copies
conclusion: cannot be executed on this host: the two historical backup dumps it is defined against do not exist here, and no synthetic stand-in was used

the_two_acceptances.guard: quota_upgrade_pg_test.go:17 skips unless the switch is set, and the file comment states it runs only on a separately restored old-populated.dump after the three new migrations, with no fixture insert or cleanup of its own
the_two_acceptances.needs: old-populated.dump restored into a disposable copy, then migrations 20260923130000_gpu_sqlc.sql, 20260923130100_gpu_no_rls_catalog.sql, 20260923130200_gpu_sync_ref.sql and 20260923143455_drop_geo_location.sql applied, then the gpu runtime-grant, restrict-database and rls-audit SQL scripts

the_two_acceptances.guard: quota_gpu_pg_test.go:337 skips unless the switch is set; the file comment states it does not seed or clean the restored rows
the_two_acceptances.needs: new-populated.dump restored into a second disposable copy with the same grant scripts, plus the documented lost-ACK projection fault applied to that copy only (sql/gpu/ops/restore_pending_projection.sql)

required_inputs_and_where_they_are_recor.procedure: docs/evidence/gov-quota-ent-review-20260924/history.sh is the pre-takeover script this acceptance is defined by, including the per-copy createdb/pg_restore, the migration and grant order, the flock, the disposable-copy-only fault injection and the two DSNs

search_performed_on_this_host.absent_path: /home/chabking does not exist on this host (ls: No such file or directory)
search_performed_on_this_host.filesystem_search: find over /home/ubuntu and /tmp for *populated*.dump returned nothing; a broader search for *.dump, *.tar and *gov-data* returned nothing outside documentation
search_performed_on_this_host.documents_only: the only hits are pre-takeover evidence documents under /home/ubuntu/tx7do-pilot-run/T07/premigrate-ref/docs/evidence/..., i.e. text describing the backups, not the backups
search_performed_on_this_host.no_container_holds_them: the running containers are the task's lab and guard postgres plus an unrelated T04 redis; no authorized restore copy of these dumps exists in any of them, and the gate's own gov_acc_data / gov_acc_lab databases are explicitly not the historical source

not_substituted: no empty or freshly migrated database was restored and reported as a historical restore
the switch-gated tests were not run without their switches to manufacture a result: both t.Skip, and a skip is never recorded as a pass

the ordinary quota tests inside make verify-gpu (TestQuotaGpu, TestQuotaProcess, TestQuotaEnt, the concurrent/lease/policy race cases and the lab regression) are a different acceptance and are reported separately in migration/receipts/T15-r4-verify-gpu.json
no authorization was assumed to fetch or recreate the dumps from somewhere else

what_would_complete_it.input_needed: the two dump files, or an authorized location for equivalents, with sha256 verified against docs/evidence/gov-quota-ent-review-20260924/historical-inputs.sha256
then: create two task-named disposable databases, e.g. tx7do_t15_r6_upgrade and tx7do_t15_r6_projection, from the recorded admin DSN, never from a running lab database
pg_restore each dump with --no-owner --no-acl --exit-on-error into its own copy and keep the restore log
apply the migration and grant sequence from history.sh to the upgrade copy, and the same plus restore_pending_projection.sql fault to the projection copy

run QUOTA_UPGRADE_VERIFY=1 go test -tags quota_pg ./app/admin/service/internal/data -run '^TestQuotaGpuOldPopulatedUpgradeReplay$' -count=1 -v -timeout=5m with QUOTA_LAB_PG_DSN pointing only at the upgrade copy
then, serially, QUOTA_RESTORE_VERIFY=1 ... -run '^TestQuotaGpuRestoredProjectionContinuation$' ... against the projection copy
record both named results and their real exit codes, drop only the two task copies, and leave the source databases unchanged
what_would_complete_it.blocker_owner: the backups are an input this repository does not carry; the missing item is the files themselves
